title: krn adopt --refresh restores the pinned site skills over the source repository's own newer copies
body:
Source: S29 rehearsal 2026-11-16, krn adopt on a scratch clone of boilerplate-2026 main 2fb16ac (logs .krn/tmp/s29/adopt2.log, t1.log post-adopt suite, t26.log pristine suite under the pinned Node 26: 62 pass, 2 fail only from an untrusted mise config in a temp dir).
Follow-up of t-1ap8rdz: plain adopt now keeps existing site skills, but --refresh/--refresh-all (suggested by krn doctor pack-remedy) still writes the pin from boilerplate commit 30778b5 over boilerplate-2026's newer skills.
Outcome: refresh never writes a site skill into the repository named in src/adopt/site-skills/source.json, and reports an edited copy elsewhere as drift without overwriting unless --force.
Proof: node --test test/adopt/skill-set.test.ts: pass.
